project_name: Wallets on the Fly - v3 features

clauses.title: Peer-to-peer transfers
clauses.text: Send and request money between PayNest users by phone number or contact, with confirmation screen, limits from the existing risk engine and push receipts.

clauses.title: Savings pots v2
clauses.text: Up to 10 named savings pots per user with goal amount, target date, progress ring and manual top-up / withdraw.

clauses.title: Card controls
clauses.text: Freeze / unfreeze card, show PIN, and set per-category spending limits through the existing card-processor API.

clauses.title: Dark mode
clauses.text: System-following dark theme for all v3 screens on iOS and Android, meeting WCAG AA contrast.

clauses.title: Notification revamp
clauses.text: New push notification templates for transfers, card events and pot milestones, with per-type opt-out in settings.

clauses.title: Wallet provisioning
clauses.text: Apple Pay, Google Pay and other device wallet provisioning are not included.

clauses.title: New channels
clauses.text: A web app or desktop version of the wallet is not included.

clauses.title: Analytics features
clauses.text: Spending reports, insights, budgets or emailed statements beyond the existing transaction list are not included.

clauses.title: Provider migrations
clauses.text: Changing KYC, card-processor or banking providers is not included.

clauses.title: Sandbox access
clauses.text: PayNest provides card-processor sandbox credentials and test cards by 20 July 2026.

clauses.title: Design system
clauses.text: Screens follow the existing PayNest design system; new visual identity work is not assumed.

clauses.title: Defect warranty
clauses.text: Defects against the agreed acceptance criteria, reported within 60 days of go-live, are fixed at no charge.

clauses.title: Change requests
clauses.text: Anything not listed under S-clauses is a change request: Empower estimates it, PayNest approves the price in writing, then work is scheduled.

clauses.title: Defect backlog
clauses.text: Fix the 64 P1/P2 defects in the agreed backlog (Jira filter KI-STAB) in the claims portal and adjuster console.

clauses.title: Performance
clauses.text: Bring the five slowest pages (claims list, claim detail, document upload, reports, exports) under 2 seconds at the 95th percentile with 500 concurrent users.

clauses.title: Monitoring
clauses.text: Application monitoring, error alerting to the Kiwi Insure on-call channel and a weekly stability report.

clauses.title: New claim types
clauses.text: New insurance products or claim types (forms, rules, workflows) are not included.

clauses.title: New integrations
clauses.text: Integrations with systems not already connected to the portal are not included.

clauses.title: Redesign
clauses.text: Visual redesign or rebranding of the portal is not included; layout fixes needed to resolve backlog defects are.

clauses.title: Environments
clauses.text: Kiwi Insure provides a production-like staging environment with anonymised data.

clauses.title: Defect warranty
clauses.text: Regressions caused by Empower's changes, reported within 30 days of each release, are fixed at no charge.

clauses.title: Change requests
clauses.text: Work outside S1-S3 is quoted as a change request at the rates in this SOW and needs written approval.

clauses.title: Arabic localisation
clauses.text: Arabic (right-to-left) for every screen of the driver app and the dispatcher web console, including dates, numbers and maps labels.

clauses.title: iPad dispatcher
clauses.text: A dispatcher layout for iPad (portrait and landscape) with live map, job board and driver chat.

clauses.title: Offline maps
clauses.text: Offline map tiles cached for the driver's planned route, refreshed when the device is online.

clauses.title: Other languages
clauses.text: Languages other than English and Arabic (e.g. Urdu, Hindi) are not included.

clauses.title: Android tablets
clauses.text: Android tablet layouts are not included.

clauses.title: Telematics hardware
clauses.text: Integration with vehicle telematics devices or new hardware is not included.

clauses.title: Translations
clauses.text: Gulf Freight Lines supplies and approves all Arabic translations; Empower provides the string files.

clauses.title: Map provider
clauses.text: The existing Google Maps contract and API keys are used.

clauses.title: Defect warranty
clauses.text: Defects against acceptance criteria reported within 60 days of go-live are fixed at no charge.

clauses.title: Change requests
clauses.text: Additional features are estimated and priced as change requests before work starts.

clauses.title: Lead scoring
clauses.text: A configurable lead-scoring rules engine (up to 25 rules) with score history on each lead.

clauses.title: Salesforce sync
clauses.text: Two-way sync of contacts and opportunities with MediLink's Salesforce org, every 15 minutes, with conflict log.

clauses.title: Sales dashboard
clauses.text: A sales dashboard with six KPIs: pipeline value, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, new leads, activities per rep.

clauses.title: Access control
clauses.text: Role-based access for three roles: rep, manager, admin.

clauses.title: Marketing automation
clauses.text: Email campaigns, newsletters and marketing automation are not included.

clauses.title: Mobile app
clauses.text: A native mobile CRM app is not included; the web app is responsive.

clauses.title: Data migration
clauses.text: Migration of data from HubSpot or other legacy CRMs is not included.

clauses.title: Salesforce limits
clauses.text: MediLink's Salesforce Enterprise edition API limits are sufficient for 15-minute sync.

clauses.title: Defect warranty
clauses.text: Defects against acceptance criteria reported within 60 days of go-live are fixed at no charge.

clauses.title: Change requests
clauses.text: Changes to agreed scope are raised as change requests, estimated at the SOW rates and approved in writing.
